## Checklist

- [ ] `go vet ./... && go test ./...` passes locally
- [ ] Tests were written first and observed failing before the change
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or config changed (`README.md`, `docs/configuration.md`, `docs/system-under-test.md`)
- [ ] Design doc added or updated under `docs/design/` for new grants, endpoints, or token formats
- [ ] Docker image still builds if `Dockerfile`, `go.mod`, or `cmd/` changed
